newsitem.title: USA: Designer Holdings finishes 2.4 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Designer Holdings finishes 2.4 mln shr offer.

text.p: Designer Holdings Ltd said Friday that it has completed a 2.4 million share offering of its six percent convertible trust originated preferred securities. This represents $120 million issued by its Designer Holdings Finance Trust affiliate, the company said.

The securities are convertible into Designer common stock at $23.52 per share, representing a premium of 23 percent, the company said. Underwriters have an over-allotment option to buy an additional $18 million.
Designer Holdings said proceeds will be used to repay term debt and to reduce outstanding borrowings under its revolving credit facility.
Merrill Lynch & Co Inc and Morgan Stanley & Co Inc managed the offering, the company said.
